name: Dummy×Love
source:
At the park, Fuuka picks up a puppy that seems to be a stray.
However, it turns out to be a fairy that looks exactly like a puppy.

By revealing her real name to the fairy, a contract is formed,
and she must find a lover to save the world.

――Who will you choose as your lover?

[Translated from [url=https://lllakolll.xxxxxxxx.jp/2014AF/index.html]official website[/url]]
translation:
枫椛在公园里捡到了一只似乎无家可归的小狗。
然而，它其实是个外表与小狗一模一样的妖精。

因为向妖精透露了自己的真名，她与它缔结了契约。
为了拯救世界，她必须找到一位恋人。

——你会选择谁成为恋人？

[译自[url=https://lllakolll.xxxxxxxx.jp/2014AF/index.html]官方网站[/url]]
